Financial Statements 2023|website=icicilombard.com}} | operating_income = {{profit}} {{INRConvert|2112|c}} (2023) | net_income = {{profit}} {{INRConvert|1729|c}} (2023) | assets = {{profit}} {{INRConvert|50848|c}} (2023) | equity = {{profit}} {{INRConvert|9468|c}} (2023) | num_employees = 10,236 (2021) | parent = [[ICICI Bank]] | website = [http://www.icicilombard.com www.icicilombard.com] }} '''ICICI Lombard General Insurance Company Limited''' is an Indian [[general insurance]] company headquartered in [[Mumbai]], [[Maharashtra]]. ICICI is engaged with [[general insurance]], [[reinsurance]], [[Insurance|insurance claims management]] and [[investment management]].{{cite web|title=About ICICI Lombard|url=http://www.icicigroupcompanies.com/about_us.html|access-date=26 November 2014|archive-date=17 November 2014|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20141117052709/http://icicigroupcompanies.com/about_us.html|url-status=dead}} The company has a [[Gross Written Premium]] of ₹306.18 billion (FY2026). It offers [[Policy|policy insurance]] and renewal through its intermediaries and website. It markets assurance products including [[Vehicle insurance|Car Insurance]], [[Health insurance|Health Insurance]], [[Travel insurance|International Travel Insurance]], Overseas Student [[Travel insurance|Travel Insurance]], [[Two-wheeler insurance|Two Wheeler Insurance]], [[Home insurance|Home Insurance]] and [[Weather insurance|Weather Insurance]].{{cite news|title=ICICI Lombard to be restrictive towards weather insurance|url=http://www.business-standard.com/article/pti-stories/icici-lombard-to-be-restrictive-towards-weather-insurance-114121800167_1.html|access-date=13 August 2015|work=Business Standard|agency=Press Trust of India|date=18 December 2014|location=Mumbai}} == History == Founded in 2001, ICICI Lombard General Insurance Company is a joint venture between [[ICICI Bank]]- India’s second-largest bank, and [[Fairfax Financial]] Holdings Limited- a financial services company based in [[Toronto]]. [[ICICI Bank]] had 64% stake in the venture while Fairfax had 36% in the joint venture. ICICI Lombard General Insurance is the largest private-sector general insurance company in India.{{cite news |author1=Anirudh Laskar |title=ICICI Lombard, Bharti AXA to merge general insurance businesses |url=https://www.livemint.com/companies/news/icici-lombard-bharti-axa-to-merge-general-insurance-businesses-11598068493984.html |access-date=24 August 2020 |work=Livemint |date=22 August 2020 |language=en}} In a 2016 fiscal, ICICI Bank sold a 9.0% stake in ICICI General to its joint venture partner, Fairfax Financial Holdings, at a company valuation of {{INRConvert|172.25|b|lk=off|year=2016|to=USD}}.{{Cite web |title=ICICI sells 9% stake in general insurance arm to JV partner Fairfax |url=https://www.myinsuranceclub.com/insurance-news/icici-sells-9-stake-in-general-insurance-arm-to-jv-partner-fairfax |access-date=2022-04-04 |website=MyInsuranceClub |language=en}} Following the transaction, the share ownership in ICICI Lombard General Insurance Company of [[ICICI Bank]] and [[Fairfax Financial]] Holdings Limited is approximately 64% and 35%, respectively. On 16th October 2019, FAL Corporation, part of Fairfax Financial Holdings, exited ICICI Lombard General Insurance Company Ltd. by selling shares, which at the time were worth nearly {{INRConvert|2,627|c|lk=off|year=2019|to=USD}}{{Cite news |title=FAL Corp exits ICICI Lombard; sells stake worth Rs 2,627 crore |work=The Economic Times |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/stocks/news/fal-corp-exits-icici-lombard-sells-stake-worth-rs-2627-crore/articleshow/71620271.cms |access-date=2022-04-04}} ICICI Lombard General Insurance Company partnered with [[Karur Vysya Bank]] to sell [[bancassurance]] products in 2019.{{cite news |title=ICICI Lombard, Karur Vysya Bank tie up for sale of insurance products |url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/pti-stories/icici-lombard-karur-vysya-bank-tie-up-for-bancassurance-partnership-119103001536_1.html |access-date=24 August 2020 |work=Business Standard India |agency=Press Trust of India |date=30 October 2019}} In August 2020, ICICI Lombard General Insurance Company acquired Bharti Axa Insurance General, through a [[Stock swap|share swap deal]].{{cite news |title=ICICI Lombard, Bharti AXA to merge in share swap deal to form 3rd largest general insurer |url=https://indianexpress.com/article/business/companies/icici-lombard-bharti-axa-to-merge-in-share-swap-deal-to-form-3rd-largest-general-insurer-6565974/ |access-date=24 August 2020 |work=The Indian Express |date=23 August 2020 |language=en}} The deal enabled Bharti AXA's current shareholders to receive 2 shares of ICICI Lombard for every 115 shares of Bharti AXA held. The merger resulted in a combined annual premiums, worth {{INRConvert|16447|c}}.{{cite news |title=ICICI Lombard to merge Bharti AXA's non-life insurance biz with self, create 3rd largest player |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/stocks/news/icici-lombard-to-merge-bharti-axas-non-life-insurance-biz-with-self-create-3rd-largest-player/articleshow/77688820.cms |access-date=24 August 2020 |work=The Economic Times |date=22 August 2020}}{{cite news |title=ICICI Lombard to acquire Bharti Axa General Insurance; stock slips over 1% |url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/markets/icici-lombard-to-acquire-bharti-axa-general-insurance-stock-slips-over-1-120082400413_1.html |access-date=24 August 2020 |work=Business Standard India |date=24 August 2020}} ICICI Lombard General Insurance Company has 13,670 employees, 312 branches(2024){{Cite web |date=March 31, 2024 |title=Link to number of branch's and staff as of 2024 |url=https://www.icicilombard.com/about-us/who-we-are |access-date=19 August 2024 |website=www.icicilombard.com}} 840 virtual offices{{efn|Details on the number of virtual offices detailed in Performance Review (refer page #7) of ICICI Lombard for Financial year 2020 conducted by the parent company ICICI Bank Ltd.{{cite web |url=https://www.icicibank.com/managed-assets/docs/investor/quarterly-financial-results/2020/2020-Investor-Presentation-Q4-2020-ICICILombard-General-Insurance.pdf |title=Performance Review FY2020 |work=ICICI Bank |access-date=24 August 2020 |archive-date=2 February 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230202153940/https://www.icicibank.com/managed-assets/docs/investor/quarterly-financial-results/2020/2020-Investor-Presentation-Q4-2020-ICICILombard-General-Insurance.pdf |url-status=dead }}}} spread across India. ==Financials== ICICI Lombard's Gross Written Premium was {{INRConvert|306.18|b|lk=off|year=2026|to=USD}} in the 2026 fiscal year. ICICI Lombard had the second highest industry market share of 8.30 percent in the general insurance market as of February 2022.{{Cite news |last=Rebello |first=Joel |title=PSU general insurers lose market share; New India bucks trend |work=The Economic Times |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/stocks/news/psu-general-insurers-lose-market-share-new-india-bucks-trend/articleshow/90138624.cms?from=mdr |access-date=2022-04-04}} ICICI Lombard’s profit before tax increased from ₹16.83 billion in fiscal 2022 to ₹21.12 billion in fiscal 2023. ICICI Lombard’s profit after tax increased from ₹12.71 billion in fiscal 2022 to ₹17.29 billion in fiscal 2023.{{Cite web |title=ICICI Lombard General Insurance Company Profit & Loss account, ICICI Lombard General Insurance Company Financial Statement & Accounts |url=https://www.icicilombard.com/docs/default-source/financial-information/outcomefinal.pdf?sfvrsn=39fd6bea_6|access-date=18 April 2023 |website=www.icicilombard.com |language=en}} ==Footnotes== {{Notelist}} ==References== {{Reflist|2}} == External links == *{{Official website}} {{Insurance in India}} {{Nifty 200 companies}} {{ICICI Group}} {{Authority control}} [[Category:2001 establishments in Maharashtra]] [[Category:Financial services companies established in 2001]] [[Category:Indian companies established in 2001]] [[Category:Financial services companies based in Mumbai]] [[Category:General insurance companies of India]] [[Category:ICICI Bank]] [[Category:Multinational joint-venture companies]] [[Category:Fairfax Financial]] [[Category:Companies listed on the National Stock Exchange of India]] [[Category:Companies listed on the Bombay Stock Exchange]]

ICICI Lombard General Insurance Company Limited is an Indian general insurance company headquartered in Mumbai, Maharashtra. ICICI is engaged with general insurance, reinsurance, insurance claims management and investment management. 
The company has a Gross Written Premium of ₹306.18 billion (FY2026). It offers policy insurance and renewal through its intermediaries and website. It markets assurance products including Car Insurance, Health Insurance, International Travel Insurance, Overseas Student Travel Insurance, Two Wheeler Insurance, Home Insurance and Weather Insurance.
